source_note: Public-safe snapshot derived from CF-0 canonical sources and owner handoffs. This is a navigation overlay, not the authoritative task registry, live status monitor, or full private-chat export.

actions.title: Recover the expiring private ChatGPT export
actions.detail: If not already saved, open the export-ready message on a signed-in Windows browser and save its ZIP privately. The earlier download window was reported to end around Nov 10, 1:49 PM Eastern; this snapshot cannot see your local download.
actions.action: Check the email and preserve the file privately; never put it on public GitHub.
actions.label: Open your mail
actions.proof: Private ZIP successfully downloaded and verified locally
actions.caution: No secrets or signed export URLs in public notes; if link expired, use official export/support recovery.

actions.title: Bridge Builders — preserve reply/receipt
actions.detail: The $1,500 microgrant was owner-reported submitted Nov 9; official receipt and applicant eligibility were not independently verified. Deadline Nov 13, 2026.
actions.action: If a response arrives, answer truthful eligibility/venue questions and keep the official confirmation privately. Do not submit a duplicate application.
actions.label: Grant record

actions.title: AUTO-08 — one-chat Windows acceptance
actions.detail: Live signed-in behavior has not been verified by the public code tests; older v0.1.1 instructions are superseded. HP relay is a separate paused system.
actions.action: On the Windows Chrome account you chose, use the current v0.1.6 guide. Check readiness, run exactly one low-stakes conversation, verify one 'continue' and completed reply, then STOP. Keep fast sweep OFF.
actions.label: Current installation and test guide
actions.proof: Owner-observed one send, one complete reply, STOP blocks further sends
actions.caution: Do not restart the paused HP relay; do not open multiple working ChatGPT tabs.

actions.title: Put this cockpit on your iPhone Home Screen
actions.detail: The link launcher is an installable public web app, not an App Store app; a device-side test has not been witnessed.
actions.action: Open this page in Safari → Share → Add to Home Screen. Reopen it, refresh public links, and try an action link.
actions.label: Open Home Screen launcher
actions.proof: Home Screen icon opens your same Link Vault
actions.caution: Personal checked-off actions save only in this browser unless exported.

actions.title: Share First Drop once from your social account
actions.detail: Public campaign content is ready; an independent outside post or donation is not verified from public evidence.
actions.action: Share the official First Drop page only through an account you choose to use.
actions.label: Official campaign page
actions.proof: Real external post URL or independent response
actions.caution: Voluntary donations only; no fabricated supporters or payments.

actions.title: Approve real $5 / $15 service checkout when ready
actions.detail: Clarity Check and Clarity Brief are inquiry pilots; automated checkout, first outside buyer and settlement are not verified.
actions.action: Only when an actual buyer or platform setup requires it, personally approve payout/checkout details in the official service. Do not share passwords or bank data here.
actions.label: View $5 offer
actions.proof: Buyer acceptance, deliverable completion, verified independent payment
actions.caution: A link, test/self-payment, inquiry or grant submission is not revenue.

actions.title: Locate the existing PRIVATE Contacts workbook
actions.detail: There is one canonical private registry, Caveman_Focus_PRIVATE_Contacts.xlsx. Its permanent private storage location has not been verified.
actions.action: Keep the original in owner-controlled private storage; if a chat needs to update it, supply that existing file/location rather than creating another.
actions.label: Privacy and continuity rule
actions.proof: Existing private file located, no duplicate registry
actions.caution: Never upload contact rows or private Drive links to public CF-0.

actions.title: Provide original lost project list if recovered
actions.detail: The original approximately 37-project list and complete verbatim transcripts are not recovered; later 62-entry lists are reconstructions.
actions.action: If you find an original list, official export or other-account archive, keep it private and share only through a private workspace.
actions.label: Continuity gap
actions.proof: Verbatim source and provenance reconciled, not only a summary
actions.caution: No raw chat exports in public repository.

actions.title: Finish free storage account verification only at an actual gate
actions.detail: The free redundancy plan may require manual sign-in, verification or CAPTCHA; no third-party account is presumed created.
actions.action: When a specific provider step blocks setup, complete only its official authentication screen and report whether setup succeeded; use no paid tier.
actions.label: Storage/continuity context
actions.proof: Provider confirms account exists and storage can be retrieved
actions.caution: No credentials in chat or public files.

actions.title: Review unfamiliar account security alerts
actions.detail: Older account alerts may be routine or may need attention; no specific login is declared unauthorized here.
actions.action: Only if you do not recognize a sign-in or recovery change, review it in the provider's official security settings and revoke unknown sessions.
actions.label: Google account security
actions.proof: Owner confirmed recognized or secured account
actions.caution: Never paste password, recovery codes or signed URLs into chat.

actions.title: Respond to a real grant or venue clarification
actions.detail: Bridge Builders eligibility, category and workshop venue/partner details were previously questioned; no venue or partnership should be invented.
actions.action: If the funder, library or Parks & Recreation replies, decide accurate applicant/category/venue details and retain their actual message privately.
actions.label: Application support draft
actions.proof: Written request and truthful completed response
actions.caution: No invented endorsements, signatures or partner commitments.

actions.title: HP scheduler and relay — maintenance HOLD
actions.detail: The three named HP scheduled tasks were reported disabled for maintenance. Physical scheduler attribution remains unverified.
actions.action: No restart is requested. Later, separately choose a backup/repair plan and authorize any re-enable after local review.
actions.label: HP maintenance record
actions.proof: Future owner-approved local restore and attributed scheduled receipt
actions.caution: Do not turn on FastLane, Relay or Supervisor from this checklist.

actions.title: Hacker Initiative 2026 — response watch
actions.detail: Application submitted Nov 9, 2026. A reply watch is enabled; submission is not an award.
actions.action: No new submission needed now. Respond through the official channel if genuine follow-up requests arrive.
actions.label: Program website
actions.proof: Official reply, award notice or payment, as applicable
actions.caution: Do not submit a duplicate grant.

actions.title: Review publication/ownership terms before legal commitments
actions.detail: Public source names a creator/developer and a designated owner/intended beneficiary, but legal transfer is not independently established.
actions.action: Before signing or granting exclusive rights, check the actual agreement and decide what you are making public; seek legal review for binding transfers.
actions.label: Provenance record
actions.caution: Public-source labels alone do not create enforceable ownership transfers.

actions.title: Reddit / community promotion sign-in, if used
actions.detail: Promotion sources exist, but not every community account, post, or membership was verified.
actions.action: Only if you choose to post there, complete your own sign-in/verification and follow the community rules; no paid account required.
actions.label: Free promotion guide
actions.caution: Don't make duplicate or misleading posts.

actions.title: Cloud watchdog, link tests and source reconciliation
actions.detail: Source tests and public updates can proceed without owner screenshots or repeated PowerShell copy/paste.
actions.action: Assistant-owned: work from existing GitHub proofs and report actual commits/tests.
actions.label: Mission board
actions.caution: Cloud CI ≠ real HP scheduler execution.

actions.title: Cross-chat continuity and lost-source audit
actions.detail: Private originals remain incomplete; assistants should reconcile accessible sources without demanding all manual work from you.
actions.action: Assistant-owned: audit provenance, keep distinct records linked, and request only a genuinely missing private source.
actions.label: Mesh protocol
actions.proof: Linked evidence/handoff with missing items clearly marked

actions.title: Funding replies and actual sales evidence
actions.detail: Existing monitors can watch authorized channels; they do not convert submissions to grants or offers to paid orders.
actions.action: Assistant-owned: watch and classify responses, prepare truthful offers, prompt for approval only at real gates.
actions.label: Business workstream
actions.proof: Actual provider reply and separate settled payment proof
